question: Which of the following was the first Satyagraha Movement led by Mahatma Gandhi in British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Champaran Satyagraha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Champaran Satyagraha** was the first Satyagraha movement led by Mahatma Gandhi in British India in 1917.
 
• This movement was initiated to address the grievances of farmers in the Champaran district of Bihar, who were forced to grow indigo under oppressive conditions imposed by British planters.
